summary: PSQ Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a private placement of 361,385 shares of Class A common stock at $3.60 per share, raising $1.3 million in gross proceeds from directors and affiliates. The transaction closed on August 13, 2026, with proceeds for working capital. The company agreed to file a registration statement within 90 days. This is a routine capital raise, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition or restructuring. The filing is a standard disclosure under Items 1.01 and 3.02, with no unusual structural elements or strategic implications beyond ordinary financing.
